extraction.notes: Annex covering all five Western Balkan partners. Read in full: the general part on monitoring and the scoreboard (pages 1-3), the North Macedonia tables of Appendix 1 (pages 39-54), the North Macedonia allocation table of Appendix 2 (page 67) and the indicator list of Appendix 3 (page 69). Pages 4-38 and 55-66 (Albania, Kosovo, Montenegro and Serbia) were not extracted; page 68 is near-empty (register notes ocr). Each payment condition is one item, typed recommendation as an EU-approved condition for payment (the steps originate in the Reform Agenda but are set by the Commission decision as conditions); deadlines are recorded in extraction_note, not as event dates, because they are targets rather than events. All items carry the table flag. No Chapter 2 material: the guarantee mechanism for employees' claims (page 46) and the Labour Inspectorate targets (page 46) are general labour-market or insolvency matters outside the run record's Chapter 2 boundary. Left out as not material under rules 0.4: the Ministry of Finance transitory IT project database (page 40, back-office); teacher training in digital skills and curricula integrating the European Digital Competence Framework (page 45, digital skills not linked to an in-scope recommendation); the SAMIS state aid system precondition (page 47, back-office); the ICT priority area of the smart specialisation matchmaking and the innovation centres (page 48); Intelligent Transport Systems, eFTI and the eCMR convention (page 51, transport digital systems, out by default); the court case management system ACCMIS (page 52) and the asset management case software (page 54) (back-office); digital forensic analysts (page 53). Theme-doubtful items (school connectivity, para-fiscal digital register, e-customs systems, drugs Early Warning System) are extracted and flagged for the analyst. Appendix 3 indicator 11 (extent to which a NIS2 cyber resilience framework is set up and operational) is a Commission monitoring indicator for all partners, not a claim; not extracted. Period covered not given; left empty. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.
